description: Plan v7 section 8.3 runtime-limits clause: maximumExpressionNestingDepth pinned exactly at 1, the maximum group depth of both expressions in this catalog. ExpressionEvaluator.validateInfixTokens increments a counter on GROUP_START, throws when it exceeds the limit, and decrements on GROUP_END, so an implementation that seeded the counter at 1 for the whole expression, or that never decremented, would refuse to construct this fixture. Probe-verified: at limit 0 the library reports 'Expression grouping depth exceeds maximum supported depth 0'. Same catalog as the characters and tokens fixtures.
